sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.snippet: The Qwen3-4B is a state-of-the-art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics. This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-4B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices.
